verdict.rationale: Okta publishes an official open-source MCP server (github.com/okta/okta-mcp-server, announced on the Okta developer blog) that lets LLMs and AI agents perform Okta Admin Management operations in natural language, such as creating users, querying failed logins and listing unused apps. Missing for 10: independent or hands-on corroboration of agent connection, and in-pack documentation of setup, transport and auth configuration for connecting clients.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can connect an agent via an official MCP server

citations.quote: The Okta Open Source MCP Server integrates with LLMs and AI agents, allowing you to perform various Okta management operations using natural language.
This server is an Model Context Protocol server that provides seamless integration with Okta's Admin Management APIs.
Enterprises can now easily connect their AI agents with Okta's back
